coverage_note: Reviewed both assigned pages and all 15 assigned items, plus their declared page interfaces and direct item suppliers. Repairs and validation results are recorded in the reader report. Batch-34 and batch-68 pages were checked as interfaces; their unimported item bodies and unrelated transitive closures were not re-audited. Relevant matrix-function and Arnoldi claims were checked against [Al-Mohy and Higham, §2 and Theorem 2.1](https://eprints.maths.manchester.ac.uk/1536/3/paper16.pdf), [Niesen and Wright, §3.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0907.4631), [Higham and Lin, §7.1](https://eprints.maths.manchester.ac.uk/2067/01/covered/MIMS_ep2013_73.pdf), and [Higham, Theorems 3 and 6](https://nhigham.com/2022/01/18/what-is-the-logarithmic-norm/).
